name: Yosemite
description: Granite cliffs, waterfalls, giant sequoias, and broad valleys draw visitors year-round to the central Sierra Nevada.
directions_info: From CA-41, CA-120, or CA-140 follow posted signs into Yosemite Valley; winter chain controls are common on higher passes.
weather_info: Weather varies by elevation; summer is warm and dry in the Valley, while high country can see storms any month.

images.title: Half Dome at sunset
images.alt_text: Half Dome rising above Yosemite Valley at sunset

operating_hours.name: Yosemite National Park
operating_hours.description: Open year-round; some roads close seasonally due to snow.

name: Grand Canyon
description: A mile-deep canyon carved by the Colorado River, with sweeping views, layered geology, and diverse ecosystems.
directions_info: South Rim entrances are reached via AZ-64 from Williams or Cameron; Tusayan services sit just outside the park.
weather_info: South Rim is cool and snowy in winter; inner canyon temperatures are much hotter. Monsoon storms can bring lightning and flash floods.

images.title: View from Mather Point
images.alt_text: Colorado River and canyon layers viewed from the South Rim

operating_hours.name: Grand Canyon National Park
operating_hours.description: Open year-round; some facilities and roads have seasonal schedules.

name: Zion
description: Towering sandstone cliffs, narrow slot canyons, and the Virgin River shape a desert landscape of big walls and big hikes.
directions_info: Enter through Springdale on UT-9; shuttle service manages canyon traffic in peak season and on holidays.
weather_info: Hot summers and cool winters; afternoon thunderstorms are common in late summer and can cause flash flooding in narrow canyons.

images.title: The Watchman
images.alt_text: The Watchman peak above the Virgin River near sunset

operating_hours.name: Zion National Park
operating_hours.description: Open year-round; shuttle and facility hours vary seasonally.

exceptions.name: Zion Canyon Scenic Drive private vehicle restriction

name: Acadia
description: Rocky Atlantic coastline, spruce-fir forests, carriage roads, and granite peaks on Maine’s Mount Desert Island.
directions_info: From I-95 take ME-3 toward Ellsworth and Bar Harbor; Park Loop Road connects Ocean Drive stops like Sand Beach and Thunder Hole.
weather_info: Coastal weather changes quickly; fog and cool sea breezes are common. Winter brings ice and occasional road closures.

images.title: Cadillac Mountain sunrise
images.alt_text: Sunrise over Frenchman Bay from Cadillac Mountain summit

operating_hours.name: Acadia National Park
operating_hours.description: Open year-round; some roads close or have limited access in winter.

exceptions.name: Park Loop Road partial winter closure

name: Rocky Mountain
description: High alpine tundra, glacier-carved valleys, and wildlife viewing near Estes Park, with famed scenic drives over the Continental Divide.
directions_info: Primary access is via US-36 from Lyons/Estes Park or CO-7 from Allenspark; Trail Ridge Road is typically seasonal.
weather_info: Rapid changes are common; afternoons often bring thunderstorms in summer. Snow can occur any month at higher elevations.

images.title: Trail Ridge Road
images.alt_text: A winding road through alpine tundra with distant peaks

operating_hours.name: Rocky Mountain National Park
operating_hours.description: Open year-round; some entrances and roads have seasonal restrictions.

name: Great Smoky Mountains
description: America’s most visited national park, known for misty ridgelines, old-growth forests, historic cabins, and diverse plant life.
directions_info: Major access routes include US-441 through Newfound Gap between Gatlinburg and Cherokee, plus entrances near Townsend and Bryson City.
weather_info: Elevations vary widely; temperatures at higher elevations can be 10–20°F cooler. Summer brings humidity and afternoon storms.

images.title: Cades Cove morning
images.alt_text: Fog over a meadow with a split-rail fence in Cades Cove

entrance_fees.title: Entrance Fee
entrance_fees.description: No entrance fee is charged for this park.

operating_hours.name: Great Smoky Mountains National Park
operating_hours.description: Open year-round; some roads close temporarily due to weather.

name: Olympic
description: From glacier-capped mountains to temperate rainforests and wild Pacific beaches, Olympic protects a remarkable range of ecosystems.
directions_info: Access varies by destination; Hurricane Ridge is reached from Port Angeles via Hurricane Ridge Road, while beaches are approached from US-101 spurs.
weather_info: Rain is common, especially October through April. Mountain areas can see heavy snow; coastal fog and wind are frequent.

images.title: Hoh Rain Forest
images.alt_text: Moss-draped trees along a rainforest trail

operating_hours.name: Olympic National Park
operating_hours.description: Open year-round; some areas have seasonal access and road conditions can change quickly.

exceptions.name: Hurricane Ridge road closures during winter storms

name: Glacier
description: Jagged peaks, alpine lakes, and active glaciers in the northern Rockies, with iconic drives and abundant wildlife.
directions_info: West Glacier is reached from US-2 near Columbia Falls; St. Mary entrance is accessed from US-89 on the east side.
weather_info: Short summers and long winters; mountain weather changes rapidly. Snow can linger into July at higher elevations.

images.title: Going-to-the-Sun Road
images.alt_text: A narrow mountain road clinging to a cliff above alpine valleys

operating_hours.name: Glacier National Park
operating_hours.description: Open year-round; Going-to-the-Sun Road opens seasonally and may require timed entry in summer.

name: Joshua Tree
description: Where the Mojave and Colorado Deserts meet, Joshua Tree offers surreal rock formations, night skies, and iconic yucca woodlands.
directions_info: North entrance is near Twentynine Palms; West entrance is near the town of Joshua Tree off CA-62. Cell service is limited in the park.
weather_info: Extreme heat in summer; winter nights can be below freezing. Spring winds and occasional rain make slickrock hazardous.

images.title: Cholla Garden
images.alt_text: Cholla cactus garden lit by low afternoon sun

operating_hours.name: Joshua Tree National Park
operating_hours.description: Open year-round, 24 hours a day; visitor centers have separate hours.

name: Everglades
description: A vast subtropical wetland of sawgrass marshes and mangroves, home to alligators, crocodiles, wading birds, and manatees.
directions_info: Main access is via FL-9336 from Homestead to the Ernest F. Coe Visitor Center; Gulf Coast Visitor Center is reached through Everglades City.
weather_info: Two seasons: dry (mild, low mosquitoes) and wet (hot, humid, storms). Hurricanes are possible June through November.

images.title: Sawgrass prairie
images.alt_text: A boardwalk over sawgrass with open sky and distant tree islands

operating_hours.name: Everglades National Park
operating_hours.description: Open year-round; some areas may close during storms or high water.

name: Denali
description: North America’s highest peak rises above taiga and tundra; wildlife viewing and a single park road define the experience.
directions_info: Reach the entrance area via AK-3 (Parks Highway) near the community of Denali Park; the park road is primarily served by buses in summer.
weather_info: Cool summers and long winters; conditions can change quickly. Expect mosquitoes in mid-summer and potential snow any month.

images.title: Denali on a clear day
images.alt_text: Denali mountain towering above tundra landscape

entrance_fees.title: Per Person
entrance_fees.description: Valid for 7 consecutive days; children 15 and under are free.

operating_hours.name: Denali National Park and Preserve
operating_hours.description: Open year-round; access beyond the entrance area is seasonal and subject to road conditions.

name: Arches
description: Over 2,000 natural stone arches and fins near Moab, shaped by salt movement, erosion, and desert extremes.
directions_info: From Moab follow US-191 north and turn onto UT-313 to the entrance; timed entry may be required during peak visitation.
weather_info: Hot summers and cold winters; spring and fall are popular. Thunderstorms can create sudden runoff in washes.

images.title: Delicate Arch
images.alt_text: Delicate Arch standing on a slickrock bowl with La Sal Mountains behind

operating_hours.name: Arches National Park
operating_hours.description: Open year-round; visitor center hours vary by season.

name: Cuyahoga Valley
description: A green corridor between Cleveland and Akron with canals, waterfalls, and historic sites along the Cuyahoga River.
directions_info: Access points are spread along OH-8 and I-271; the Towpath Trail and visitor centers are reached via local roads in Brecksville and Boston Mill.
weather_info: Four distinct seasons; spring floods can affect trails. Winter brings ice on boardwalks and closures after heavy snow.

images.title: Brandywine Falls
images.alt_text: A waterfall cascading into a gorge with a viewing platform

entrance_fees.title: Entrance Fee
entrance_fees.description: No entrance fee is charged for this park.

operating_hours.name: Cuyahoga Valley National Park
operating_hours.description: Open daily; trails and sites may have posted hours.

name: Biscayne
description: Mostly underwater, Biscayne protects coral reefs, islands, and a maritime heritage just south of Miami.
directions_info: From Florida’s Turnpike or US-1, take SW 328th St (North Canal Dr) east to the Dante Fascell Visitor Center near Homestead Bayfront.
weather_info: Hot, humid summers with thunderstorms; mild winters. Water conditions and winds can change quickly for boaters.

images.title: Biscayne Bay shoreline
images.alt_text: Shallow turquoise water with mangroves along the shore

entrance_fees.title: Entrance Fee
entrance_fees.description: No entrance fee is charged; fees apply for some tours and permits.

operating_hours.name: Dante Fascell Visitor Center
operating_hours.description: Visitor center hours vary seasonally; the park is open year-round.

name: Cumberland Gap
description: A gateway through the Appalachians where Native peoples and later settlers traveled west; today it offers trails, overlooks, and history.
directions_info: Use US-25E to reach the visitor center near Middlesboro, KY; follow signs to Pinnacle Overlook and trailheads along the parkway.
weather_info: Warm, humid summers and cool winters; fog is common in valleys. Storms can bring downed trees and temporary trail closures.

images.title: Pinnacle Overlook
images.alt_text: Overlook view across forested ridges in the Appalachians

entrance_fees.title: Entrance Fee
entrance_fees.description: No entrance fee is charged for this park.

operating_hours.name: Cumberland Gap National Historical Park
operating_hours.description: Park grounds open daily; visitor center has posted hours.

name: Badlands
description: Eroded buttes, pinnacles, and layered rock formations create dramatic scenery and rich fossil beds on the Northern Plains.
directions_info: Interstate 90 provides access via exits for Wall and Interior; SD-240 (Badlands Loop Road) connects viewpoints and trailheads through the park.
weather_info: Hot summers, cold winters, and strong winds. Thunderstorms can be intense; check forecasts for lightning and hail.

images.title: Badlands formations
images.alt_text: Layered rock spires under a blue sky

operating_hours.name: Badlands National Park
operating_hours.description: Open year-round; some facilities have reduced winter hours.

exceptions.name: Ben Reifel Visitor Center reduced winter hours

name: Cape Hatteras
description: Barrier island beaches, shifting sands, and historic lighthouses along North Carolina’s Outer Banks, shaped by wind and surf.
directions_info: Access the Outer Banks via US-64, US-158, or NC-12; ferry routes connect Ocracoke and Hatteras with seasonal schedules.
weather_info: Ocean winds and rapidly changing conditions are common. Hurricane season can cause overwash and road closures on NC-12.

images.title: Cape Hatteras Lighthouse
images.alt_text: Black-and-white spiral lighthouse against a bright sky

entrance_fees.title: Entrance Fee
entrance_fees.description: No entrance fee is charged for this seashore.

operating_hours.name: Cape Hatteras National Seashore
operating_hours.description: Beaches are generally open 24 hours; some ramps and areas close for resource protection or storms.

name: Katmai
description: Remote Alaska wilderness famous for brown bears, salmon runs, and the Valley of Ten Thousand Smokes volcanic landscape.
directions_info: Most visitors arrive by air taxi or boat from King Salmon; Brooks Camp is the primary access point during summer season.
weather_info: Coastal storms and fog can delay flights; temperatures are generally cool. Bring rain gear and expect variable conditions.

images.title: Bears at Brooks Falls
images.alt_text: Brown bears fishing at a waterfall during salmon run

entrance_fees.title: Entrance Fee
entrance_fees.description: No entrance fee is charged; backcountry permits and camping rules apply.

operating_hours.name: Katmai National Park and Preserve
operating_hours.description: Open year-round; visitor services at Brooks Camp are seasonal.

name: Golden Gate
description: Urban parks and historic sites around San Francisco Bay, including coastal trails, forts, beaches, and iconic views of the Golden Gate Bridge.
directions_info: Sites are spread across San Francisco and Marin; use US-101 or CA-1 for Marin Headlands and Crissy Field, and local transit for city locations.
weather_info: Coastal fog and wind are common, especially in summer. Microclimates can shift sharply between shoreline and inland areas.

images.title: Golden Gate Bridge from the headlands
images.alt_text: Golden Gate Bridge spanning the strait with fog rolling in

entrance_fees.title: Entrance Fee
entrance_fees.description: No entrance fee is charged; some sites have parking or tour fees.

operating_hours.name: Golden Gate National Recreation Area
operating_hours.description: Open year-round; hours vary by site and facility.

name: World War II Memorial
description: A national memorial on the National Mall honoring Americans who served in World War II, with fountains and pillars for each state and territory.
directions_info: Located between the Lincoln Memorial and Washington Monument; Metrorail access via Smithsonian or Foggy Bottom with a short walk.
weather_info: Outdoor site with limited shade; summer heat and thunderstorms are common. Winter can bring ice and occasional closures for events.

images.title: Rainbow Pool and memorial plaza
images.alt_text: Fountains and stone pillars at the World War II Memorial

operating_hours.name: World War II Memorial
operating_hours.description: Open 24 hours a day.

name: Lassen Volcanic
description: Hydrothermal features, lava flows, and alpine lakes surround Lassen Peak, offering a compact showcase of active volcanic landscapes.
directions_info: Access via CA-89 between the towns of Mineral and Chester; the main park highway is typically closed in winter due to deep snow.
weather_info: Deep winter snow closes roads; summer days are warm with cool nights. Thunderstorms can bring lightning at higher elevations.

images.title: Bumpass Hell boardwalk
images.alt_text: Boardwalk through steaming geothermal area with mineral springs

operating_hours.name: Lassen Volcanic National Park
operating_hours.description: Open year-round, but access is seasonal; winter travel is limited to designated areas.
